Kill [[Kunvie Firewing]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill Kunvie Firewing in the [[Unwaking Waters (explorable area)|Unwaking Waters]].
* *BONUS* Kill Kunvie Firewing in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* 500 [[Kurzick Faction]]
* 500 [[Luxon Faction]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 20 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
There is an [[Oni]] [[popup]] group just to the east of Kunvie, so it is important to [[spawn]] them separately and kill them well away from any possible [[aggro]]. Kunvie and their group hit hard, so make sure that one well-protected [[party]] member or a [[tank]] takes the multiple [[Ride the Lightning]], and be sure the party is spread out to avoid multiple [[AoE]] skills. Also [[Pain Inverter]] helps a great deal in killing Kunvie.
